mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EG_WORKS (team_idx, mem_id, works_comment, works_hide, works_arlam, works_arlam_date, works_sdate, works_edate) VALUES (#{team_idx}, #{mem_id}, #{works_comment}, #{works_hide}, #{works_arlam}, #{works_arlam_date}, #{works_sdate}, #{works_edate})
mapper.update: UPDATE EG_WORKS SET works_comment = #{works_comment}, works_hide = #{works_hide}, works_arlam = #{works_arlam}, works_arlam_date = #{works_arlam_date} WHERE works_idx = #{works_idx}
UPDATE EG_WORKS SET works_del_flag = 'Y' WHERE works_idx = #{works_idx}
mapper.select: SELECT A.*, B.mem_name FROM EG_WORKS A JOIN EG_MEMBER B ON A.mem_id = B.mem_id WHERE WORKS_IDX = #{works_idx}

SELECT member.mem_name, works.mem_id, team.team_name, team.team_idx, DATE_FORMAT(team.team_regdate, '%Y-%m-%d') AS team_regdate, works.works_idx, works.works_comment, works.works_hide, works.works_arlam, works.works_arlam_date, works.works_sdate, works.works_edate, works.works_del_flag FROM EG_WORKS works JOIN EG_TEAM team ON works.team_idx = team.team_idx JOIN EG_MEMBER member ON works.mem_id = member.mem_id WHERE works.works_idx = #{works_idx}

SELECT W.*, M.MEM_NAME FROM EG_WORKS W, EG_TEAM T, EG_MEMBER M WHERE W.TEAM_IDX = T.TEAM_IDX AND W.MEM_ID = M.MEM_ID AND W.TEAM_IDX = #{team_idx} AND DATE_FORMAT(W.WORKS_SDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') <= #{date} AND DATE_FORMAT(W.WORKS_EDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') >= #{date} AND W.WORKS_HIDE = 'N' AND W.works_del_flag = 'N'
SELECT MP.MEM_ID, M.MEM_NAME FROM EG_MAPP MP, EG_MEMBER M WHERE MP.MEM_ID = M.MEM_ID AND MP.MAPP_DEL_FLAG = 'N' AND MP.TEAM_IDX = #{team_idx}
